_comment: This is a comprehensive example of background metadata format
_note: Copy this file and rename it to match your background image filename (e.g., detective_office.json for detective_office.png)
description: A detailed description of the location that helps the AI understand when to use it. Be specific about the visual elements, atmosphere, and setting details.
ai_instructions: Clear instructions for the AI about when and how to use this location. Examples: 'Use for tense confrontations', 'Perfect for private meetings', 'Ideal for action scenes'
mood: Choose from: serious, focused, welcoming, tense, dramatic, peaceful, mysterious, formal, casual, etc.

detective_office.description: A cluttered detective's office with case files scattered across the desk, dim lighting from a single lamp, and evidence boards on the walls
detective_office.ai_instructions: Use this location for investigation scenes, case discussions, private detective work, or when characters need to analyze evidence

dark_alley.description: A narrow alley behind downtown buildings, poorly lit with dumpsters and fire escapes, creating an atmosphere of danger
dark_alley.ai_instructions: Perfect for tense confrontations, secret meetings, dramatic reveals, or scenes requiring privacy and tension

cozy_cafe.description: A warm, inviting cafe with comfortable seating, soft lighting, and a relaxed atmosphere perfect for conversations
cozy_cafe.ai_instructions: Use for friendly conversations, casual meetings, relationship building, or when characters need a comfortable social setting

_field_explanations.description: Required. A one-sentence description that helps AI understand the visual and atmospheric qualities of the location.
_field_explanations.ai_instructions: Optional but recommended. Specific guidance for AI about when this location is most appropriate to use in the story.
_field_explanations.tags: Optional. Array of keywords that help the system match AI descriptions to this location. Include indoor/outdoor, mood, and functional descriptors.
_field_explanations.mood: Optional. Single word describing the overall emotional tone of the location. Used for matching AI content to appropriate visual settings.
